title: A/an and one
summary: Когда вместо неопределённого артикля a/an нужно числительное one: подчёркивание числа, one day / one morning в повествовании, числа и дроби (a hundred, one and a half), one of, а также a/an в значении «любой», «в», «такой».
ru:
## Один предмет, но два слова
Оба слова — a/an и **one** — происходят от одного древнего слова *an* (один), поэтому они пересекаются в значении, но не взаимозаменяемы. **A/an** называет предмет как «какой-то один» из класса, без упора на число. **One** — числительное, и говорящий хочет подчеркнуть, что именно **один**, а не два или больше, или противопоставить его другому числу.
> I need **a** pen. — Мне нужна ручка (любая).
> I need **one** pen, not two. — Мне нужна одна ручка, не две.
> He has **a** brother and **two** sisters. — У него брат и две сестры. (называем, не считаем)
> She has **one** brother — just one. — У неё только один брат.

## Когда обязательно one
- **Подчёркивание числа или противопоставление**: *We have only **one** copy left. Not **one** student passed.* *I said **one** coffee, not two.*
- **Конструкции со словом one**: ***one** of the reasons, **one** or two days, **one** day, one by one, **one** another, **one** at a time*.
- **Часть пары или ряда**: *He closed **one** eye. On **one** hand ... on the other hand ...*

## one day, one morning и a day
В повествовании **one** вводит конкретный, но неопределённый момент в прошлом (или будущем): *One evening, while I was cooking, the lights went out.* Сравните: *I'll see you **one day*** (когда-нибудь) — а не ~~a day~~.
> **One** day I'll learn Japanese. — Когда-нибудь я выучу японский.
> It happened on **one** Friday in March. — Это случилось в одну из пятниц марта.
Противопоставление с *another / the other*: *One day she is happy, the next day she is sad.*

## Числа и дроби: a hundred или one hundred?
Перед **hundred, thousand, million, billion** в разговорной речи и неформальном письме обычно **a**: *a hundred people, a thousand pounds, a million reasons*. Формально, особенно с точными числами и в документах, — **one**: *one hundred and fifty*. Вместе с другими числами: *one hundred and twenty*, но *a hundred and twenty* тоже допустимо в разговоре.
> **one and a half** hours / **an hour and a half** — полтора часа. ~~one and half hours~~
> *a third of the money* (обычная речь) / *one third of the population* (в статистике, формально).

## A/an = любой и в значении «в / за»
- **Любой представитель класса** (обобщение): *A dog needs exercise.* (= any dog). Вместо этого можно *Dogs need...*.
- **Классификация, профессия**: *She is **an** engineer. He's **a** vegetarian.*
- **Частота или цена («за, в»)**: *twice **a** week, £2 **a** kilo, 60 miles **an** hour, once **a** year*.
- **Восклицание**: *What **a** view! Such **an** idea!*
- **Фиксированные выражения**: *a few, a little, a lot, a bit, quite **a** few, many **a** time, **a** couple of*.

## a и an: звук, а не буква
Выбор определяется **первым звуком**: *a **u**niversity [juː-], a **E**uropean, a one-way ticket* (звук [w]) — но *an **h**our, an **h**onest man, an **M**P, an **X**-ray, an **u**mbrella*.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I have an one-year-old daughter.~~ → I have **a** one-year-old daughter. (one начинается со звука [w])
- ~~two time a week~~ → **twice** a week (или *two times a week*)
- ~~We need one and half hours.~~ → We need **an hour and a half** / **one and a half hours**.
- ~~Not an student came.~~ → Not **one** student came. / Not **a single** student came.
en:
## One thing, two words
Both **a/an** and **one** come from the same Old English word *an* (one), so their meanings overlap, but they are not interchangeable. **A/an** names a thing as 'some single member of a class', without stressing the number. **One** is a numeral: the speaker stresses that it is **one**, not two or more, or contrasts it with another number.
> I need **a** pen. (any pen)
> I need **one** pen, not two.
> He has **a** brother and **two** sisters. (just naming them)
> She has **one** brother — just one.

## When one is necessary
- **Stressing the number or contrast**: *We have only **one** copy left. Not **one** student passed. I said **one** coffee, not two.*
- **Set structures with one**: ***one** of the reasons, **one** or two days, **one** day, one by one, **one** another, **one** at a time*.
- **Part of a pair or a series**: *He closed **one** eye. On **one** hand ... on the other hand ...*

## one day, one morning vs a day
In narrative, **one** introduces a specific but unspecified time in the past or future: *One evening, while I was cooking, the lights went out.* Compare: *I'll see you **one day*** (someday), not ~~a day~~.
> **One** day I'll learn Japanese.
> It happened on **one** Friday in March.
Contrast: *One day she is happy, the next day she is sad.*

## Numbers and fractions: a hundred or one hundred?
Before **hundred, thousand, million, billion**, informal English usually has **a**: *a hundred people, a thousand pounds, a million reasons*. Formally, with exact figures, **one** is preferred: *one hundred and fifty*. Both are possible in speech.
> **one and a half** hours — not ~~one and half hours~~
> **a** third of the money / **one** third (in statistics)

## A/an = any, per, such
- **Any member of a class** (generalisation): *A dog needs exercise.* (= any dog)
- **Classification, job**: *She is **an** engineer. He's **a** vegetarian.*
- **Frequency or price ('per')**: *twice **a** week, £2 **a** kilo, 60 miles **an** hour, once **a** year*.
- **Exclamations**: *What **a** view! Such **an** idea!*
- **Fixed expressions**: *a few, a little, a lot, a bit, quite **a** few, many **a** time, **a** couple of*.

## a or an: sound, not letter
The choice depends on the **first sound**: *a **u**niversity, a **E**uropean, a one-way ticket* (the sound [w]) — but *an **h**our, an **h**onest man, an **M**P, an **X**-ray, an **u**mbrella*.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I have an one-year-old daughter.~~ → I have **a** one-year-old daughter.
- ~~two time a week~~ → **twice** a week (or *two times a week*)
- ~~We need one and half hours.~~ → We need **an hour and a half** / **one and a half hours**.
- ~~Not an student came.~~ → Not **one** student came.
structure:
## a/an или one
| Значение | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| какой-то (не считаем) | a / an | She bought **a** car. |
| именно один (счёт, контраст) | one | She bought **one** car, not two. |
| какой-то момент | one + время | **One** night it snowed heavily. |
| когда-нибудь | one day | **One day** we'll travel there. |
| один из | one of | **One of** the books is missing. |
| часть пары | one ... the other | He lost **one** shoe. |

## Числа
| Разговорная | Формальная |
|---|---|
| a hundred | one hundred |
| a thousand | one thousand |
| a million | one million |
| a half | one half |
| a quarter | one quarter |
| an hour and a half | one and a half hours |

## «в / за» и «любой»
> twice **a** week · £5 **a** kilo · 50 km **an** hour · **A** child needs love.

## a и an
| Первый звук | Артикль | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| согласный звук | a | a **u**niversity, a **o**ne-way street |
| гласный звук | an | an **h**our, an **M**P, an **u**mbrella |

exercises.title: a, an или one?
exercises.instruction: Вставьте **a, an** или **one**. Если подходит несколько вариантов, укажите все.
exercises.example: We saw ___ elephant. → We saw **an** elephant.

items.text: {{One}} evening, while I was cooking, the lights went out.
I've only got {{one}} ticket left, so I can't take you both.
He drives at about sixty miles {{an}} hour.
It was {{a}} one-way ticket to Berlin.
I'm not {{a}} vegetarian, but I eat very little meat.
The tickets cost twenty pounds {{a}} person.
I go to the gym three times {{a}} week.
Bananas are one euro {{a}} kilo this week.
My salary is twenty thousand dollars {{a}} year.
The speed limit here is fifty kilometres {{an}} hour.
We pay thirty euros {{a}} night for the room.

items.q: She has ___ unusual hobby: collecting old keys.
items.why: unusual начинается с гласного звука: an unusual hobby.

items.q: I've waited for ___ and a half hours.
items.why: Перед and a half нужно число: one and a half hours.
honest начинается с гласного звука: an honest person.

items.q: She visits her grandmother ___ a month.
items.why: Рядом с a month: twice a month — устойчивая конструкция.
Конструкция one of + мн. число: one of the windows.
lovely начинается с согласного: a lovely surprise (what a).
one произносится [w…], поэтому a one-year contract.

options: I go swimming two time a week.
I go swimming twice a week.
I go swimming second a week.

items.why: MP произносится как «эм-пи», начинается с гласного звука: an MP.

options: I'd like one and half kilos of apples.
I'd like one and a half kilos of apples.
I'd like a one and half kilos of apples.
items.why: Правильная форма: one and a half.

options: Not an student passed the exam.
Not one student passed the exam.
Not one students passed the exam.
items.why: Эмфатическое отрицание: not one + ед. число (или not a single).

options: She works eight hours the day.
She works eight hours a day.
She works eight hours one day.

exercises.title: Перепишите предложение
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя конструкцию с a/an или one. Начало дано.

items.prompt: I get paid every month. → I get paid twelve times ...
answers: I get paid twelve times a year.

items.prompt: Each kilo costs three euros. → It costs three euros ...
answers: It costs three euros a kilo.
It costs three euros per kilo.
One day I'll visit Australia.
One day, I'll visit Australia.
One day, I will visit Australia.
One day I will visit Australia.

items.prompt: They have only a single child. (one) → They have ...
answers: They have only one child.

items.prompt: The journey takes 1.5 hours. (one) → The journey takes ...
answers: The journey takes one and a half hours.
The journey takes an hour and a half.

items.prompt: She phones her mother on Sundays, once every week. → She phones her mother ...
answers: She phones her mother once a week.
She phones her mother on Sundays, once a week.
She phones her mother once a week, on Sundays.
She phones her mother once a week on Sundays.

exercises.title: Исправьте ошибки
exercises.instruction: В каждом предложении есть ошибка с a/an/one. Перепишите его верно.

answers: It was a one-hour lecture.
She is a university lecturer.

items.prompt: He earns forty thousand euros an year.
answers: He earns forty thousand euros a year.

items.prompt: He waited for an hour and half.
answers: He waited for an hour and a half.
He waited for one and a half hours.

items.prompt: We need a hour to finish.
answers: We need an hour to finish.

items.prompt: Not an person came to the meeting.
answers: Not a person came to the meeting.
Not one person came to the meeting.
Not a single person came to the meeting.

items.prompt: Как часто вы ходите в спортзал или гуляете? (a week / a day)
items.sample: I go for a walk about three times a week.

items.prompt: Что вы мечтаете сделать когда-нибудь? (One day ...)
items.sample: One day I'd like to travel around the world.

items.prompt: Расскажите об одном запоминающемся вечере или утре (One evening ...).
items.sample: One evening last winter I got lost in the snow.

items.prompt: Скажите, сколько стоит ваш любимый продукт (£/€ a kilo).
items.sample: Good coffee costs about twenty euros a kilo.
